reviewNote: Consumable allowance replenishment for online questions, readings, and follow-ups. Sign in with Apple, open Data > account card > Replenish allowance, then choose the product. The intended China mainland price is CNY 6; use a China mainland Sandbox storefront. The app displays remaining allowance as a percentage. Delivery requires server verification of the Apple-signed transaction and is idempotent. Check purchases retries unfinished delivery. This is not a subscription. Sandbox allowance is isolated from production. No real payment occurs in Sandbox.
